name: Ramaladni's Icy Grasp
label: Quest
description: Ramaladni's Icy Grasp: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Fixing this band may prove to be quite challenging, friend. You see, it was made from the very runes that form inside Scourge structures - like Naxxramas. Additional materials are also required but your main concern should be getting those frozen runes. Bring me what I need and I will restore the ring to its former glory.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Frozen runes could probably be found inside Naxxramas.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ramaladni himself couldn't have done better! Here is the ring, as promised.
